audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-6].side (full layer) all read 'Skill' — a placeholder that agrees with neither champion — while content win[0-6] reads Lux, Lux, Lux, Lux, Rakan, Lux, Rakan.
audit.why: The content layer's whys[] already tell a grounded, kit-accurate story (Lux outranges Rakan's telegraphed W wind-up pre-6, Rakan's R+W flank all-in wins level 6 and late, Lux's first-item burst window flips it back once). The full layer's side/why fields were never filled in to match.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 phases[].side to match win[N], and rewrote each phases[].why to state the same reason as the paired content whys[N].

audit.why: Power spikes (early outrange while W winds up, level-6 R+W flank all-in, first-item burst punish, late fog-flank teamfighting) are already stated with grounding in content.spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two matchup-defining interactions from missingInteractions were absent: Rakan's Q sustain needs Grievous Wounds timing to shut down extended trades, and his P/E shields absorb burst and must be baited out before an all-in.
audit.why: Both change itemization and all-in sequencing and were missing in favor of a copy-pasted tradeGood/tradeBad line and a digit-free cooldowns field.
audit.corrected: Added the shield-bait fact to dosFull[1] and the anti-heal-timing fact to dontsFull[2], and added real cooldown numbers to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: E-poke the pair — the slow zone plus passive autos tax bot's formations at one.
edits.after: Level 1 you outrange Rakan — he has no poke, so chip freely with Q-E.

edits.before: Q threats begin: the double-root governs duo spacing immediately.
edits.after: Your Q-E poke beats his delayed W (Grand Entrance) wind-up trade.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-E-passive chunks pairs and the shield refunds their answer.
edits.after: You keep chipping him from safe range while his engage stays grounded.

edits.before: Chip the margins and bank the root — their engage waits on your Q's opinion.
edits.after: Your snare zones his wind-up W — bank Q for the step-up, not the poke.

edits.before: Final Spark online — rooted duos pay in pairs; the laser grades the chip war.
edits.after: His R (The Quickness) plus W flank all-in overpowers your one snare.

edits.before: First item: Q-E-R deletes squishies from root range.
edits.after: First-item burst punishes his wind-up before he peels.

edits.before: Late support Lux decides fights from a screen away: root the entry, slow the pit, laser the verdict.
edits.after: His fog flank R and W-E double dash beat your reaction — never face-check blind.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, passive-auto, bank the Q visibly — the chip is free and the threat governs.
edits.after: Force out his Fey Feathers or Battle Dance shield first — it absorbs your burst, so bait it before committing.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.
edits.after: His Q sustains allies through chip — hold Grievous Wounds itemization for extended trades, not burst all-ins.

edits.before: - Rakan Grand Entrance: matchup-defining — The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. It writes your spacing rules. - W Prismatic Barrier is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Rakan W (Grand Entrance) is 14/13/12/11/10s and knocks up on landing — track him in fog before every step-up. - E is free and re-castable, shielding on contact and absorbing burst. - R is 130/110/90s and charms on touch — respect it after level 6.

notes: Fixed a full/content level-chart mismatch: all 7 phases[].side read the placeholder 'Skill' (agreeing with neither champion) while win[] already had a real Lux/Rakan split. Moved side to match win[N] on all 7 rows and rewrote why to match the paired content whys[N].
